title: POCA threshold for returning client property raised from £1,000 to £3,000
summary: Since 31 July 2025, regulated-sector businesses can return criminal property worth less than £3,000 to a client to end the business relationship without committing a POCA money laundering offence. The limit was £1,000.
what_changes: The threshold amount in section 339A(6A) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 rose from £1,000 to £3,000.
Below this threshold, a regulated-sector business can return money or property to a client to end the relationship without a section 327-329 offence.
The separate threshold for banks and similar firms operating customer accounts also rose from £1,000 to £3,000.
who_it_applies_to: Law firms carrying on business in the regulated sector under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, such as firms doing work in scope of the Money Laundering Regulations.

history.event: Order made on 10 July 2025 and in force from 31 July 2025.
